name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance to SHG for Job Work (Fiscal Incentives to Labour Intensive Unit)
benefit: **Financial Assistance** **Activity****Quantum**Training Assistance₹5,000/- per month per member for a period of 3 monthsPayroll Assistance25% of job work value turnover limited to ₹5,000/- per month per member for 5 years
_eligibility_text:
1. The SHG must have at least 25 female members.
1. Assistance is available only for female workers of the SHG.
1. The industrial unit must pay ₹5,000/- per month per female worker in addition to the job work charges.
1. The SHG should be engaged in job work for industrial units.
